answer_old.text: All financial records including general ledgers, accounts payable and receivable, tax filings, and audit reports must be retained for a minimum of seven (7) years from the end of the fiscal year in which they were created. [POL-2025-001#3.1]

answer_new.text: All financial records including general ledgers, accounts payable and receivable, tax filings, and audit reports must be retained for a minimum of ten (10) years from the end of the fiscal year in which they were created. [POL-2025-001#3.1]

questions.question: What is the maximum value of a gift an employee may accept from one source per year?

answer_old.text: Employees may accept gifts with a market value of up to $75 from a single source in a calendar year. [POL-2025-006#2.1] Cash and cash equivalents, such as gift cards, may never be accepted. [POL-2025-006#2.1]

answer_new.text: Employees may accept gifts with a market value of up to $50 from a single source in a calendar year. [POL-2025-006#2.1] Cash and cash equivalents, such as gift cards, may never be accepted. [POL-2025-006#2.1]
